thread:
sophia: Heads up  we signed an extended PoC with Snowflake + Databricks + Milvus (vector DB) focusing on a packaged onprem + marketplace offering. We need a marketplace-ready bundle, SI onboarding docs, and an internal demo kit. Who can drive the packaging and SI runbook?

luca: I can run the packaging. Need to know target OS images, GPU families (A100 vs H100), and an expected image tag naming convention. Also: should we include a GPU driver installer in the bundle or leave as pre-req?

raj: From connector side: we'll release connector v1.2.0 with two install modes: helm chart and standalone tar. Recommend leaving drivers as pre-req and add an installer script reference. We'll add a validation job to CI.

emily: Marketplace lead here  I'll prepare the listing flow. Required items: short description, 1-click deploy manifest, architecture diagram, support SLA blurb, and customer-facing runbook. Need logos + approved partner copy. Maria, can you confirm legal phrasing?

maria: Legal: use "Joint PoC with Snowflake, Databricks, and Milvus". Partners asked for a 5-day review window before publishing any marketing material. Also request a partner co-branding guideline.

luca: Packaging notes: we'll publish two image variants: onprem-gpu:a100-2026-06-01 and onprem-gpu:h100-2026-06-01. Tagging scheme: onprem-gpu:<hw>-<yyyymmdd>. I'll open a PR with Dockerfile and release notes.

raj: PoC runbook needs a compatibility matrix: Snowflake connector version, Databricks runtime versions, Milvus index types (IVF_FLAT vs HNSW), and recommended quantization. I'll add a small config snippet for the connector: 

```
connector:
  mode: helm
  batch_size: 64
  kv_cache_prefill: 2000
  milvus_index: HNSW
```

Also include perf test harness and a sample query.

emily: For the marketplace listing, can we include a short demo script and a read-only demo account? Partners usually want a sandbox link. We need to confirm data residency regions too.

sophia: Sandbox account OK for partners only. We'll lock access and rotate creds every 24h. Maria: approve?

maria: Approved with conditions: partner NDA must cover sandbox access. I'll circulate a one-page addendum to the PoC MOU.

luca: SI handoff: suggest an SI enablement packet (2-3 day workshop agenda, runbook, playbook, known issues). Who owns training slides?

emily: Marketing can draft slides; product will review. I'll schedule a pre-launch review on 2026-05-20. Proposed timeline:
- 2026-05-12: finalize assets & legal signoff
- 2026-05-18: SI enablement session (internal)
- 2026-05-22: marketplace submission
- 2026-05-28: partner preview + soft announce

raj: CI: I'll add a nightly job that runs smoke tests against Milvus and a Snowflake dev account. Will post job links once created.

partner_ops_bot: Partner assets requested: logos, trademark usage, and environment test accounts from Snowflake/DBX/Milvus teams. ETA 72 hours. I'll post when assets arrive.

sophia: Great. Let's use Wednesday sync to walk through the SI packet and marketplace checklist. Agenda: packaging, CI, legal, sandbox access, and announcement cadence. :rocket:
